outcome: Exclusively breastfeeding ratio at 2, 4, and 6 months
Perception level of milk scale score
cohort: 341 families with healthy/term infants born between July 1st and September 30th, 2018
finding: There was no correlation between parental perception of breast milk and exclusive breastfeeding status at 6 months, however, mother's previous breastfeeding duration and pacifier use were associated with exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Mothers who delivered via cesarean section had lower breast milk perception scores, while fathers whose partners had cesarean sections had higher scores.
